changelog: fold entry files into changelog.js; re-derive merged counts

Folded and stamped by chicago-4d-changelog-fold.yml after the merge; data/liberties.json and source_use_coverage.md re-derived.

T-2380: the keeper's east gable is wall infill, not roof covering

The Gale/Trowbridge 1902 plate of the jail compound shows horizontal boarding
continuing around the loft light in the keeper's east end triangle, distinct
from the roof covering above it. The generator gave that triangle the roof
shingle material, so the pictured end read as roof where the plate shows wall.

Only the keeper's own `picture_layout == keeper_gale_1902` selector is touched:
after the native roof helper runs, the one east roof-end triangle is required to
exist and to still be M_ROOF, then takes the existing M_WALL finish. No new
parameter, geometry, board relief, loft or opening; the roof envelope, the
unpictured west end, the slopes and every dimension are unchanged.

Native rebuild with the pinned Blender 4.5.3 (hash 67807e1800cc) over the whole
affected 272-id frame_dwelling family, because the recipe hash covers the whole
producer file: 271 MASTERs measured byte-identical (their bound web derivatives
retained), one changed.

  keeper MASTER  431dc44f…52a8  70,712 B  ->  91837241…6978b  70,700 B
  keeper WEB     15eb2fba…f710e 20,632 B  ->  ed13985e…06991  20,640 B

The WEB is genuinely derived from the new MASTER by the official
tools/web_derivatives.sh, not carried over.

Accessor audit, old GLB against new: 1,590 POSITION and 794 triangles in both,
the same eight materials in the same order, and exactly one triangle — the
x=6.400 east gable end, vertices bit-identical — moved from roof_shingle to
wall. The 12-byte MASTER shrink is the exporter regrouping its primitives
(wall 316->319 verts, roof 14->11); no vertex, normal, UV or confidence value
moves. This is a material role change and nothing more.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

T-2380: refresh both jail comparisons against the rebuilt keeper

Re-rendered both reference views with tools/photo_match.mjs, so the records
bind the keeper GLB actually in the tree (91837241) rather than the superseded
431dc44f — and, in passing, the core's current dev bytes (e767412f) rather than
the ee949fa9 the records still named.

Reviewed both side-by-sides and set the verdict to `differs`, which is what they
are: four differences stay open on the Gale view and three on Andreas, led by
the core reading concealed behind the palisade where both pictures show its
walls and roof clear, the compound's wrong relative proportions, and a palisade
drawn as one flat mass where both plates draw separate boards. Neither camera is
solved; both remain diagnostic_only.

The new difference is recorded with the limit measured on the side-by-side
itself: the Gale camera meets the corrected end almost edge-on, so the change
reads there only as a thin lightened sliver along the rake (610 px, mean RGB
169 -> 186), and on Andreas the whole group is small at the right edge (93 px).
The material role is corrected; neither view demonstrates the end now matches
the plate, and no match is claimed.

LIBERTIES gains one paragraph inside the existing keeper entry, whose body is
otherwise untouched: the plate supports the ROLE of that face as wall infill and
supplies no paint, colour, board width, lap or relief, and its 1836 caption
makes it evidence of the finish as drawn then, not a July 1835 finding.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

T-2380: re-derive data/liberties.json from the amended LIBERTIES.md

compile_liberties.py output, one entry's prose; the 1,001 liberties and every
other entry are unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The plate is captioned 1836, so this is evidence of the building's finish as drawn then, not a July 1835 finding.
